title: Reset PulseAudio configuration to fix startup errors
summary: If PulseAudio fails to start or behaves erratically, deleting its user-specific configuration files and restarting the daemon can resolve the issue.

steps.explain: Remove PulseAudio's temporary and user-specific configuration files. This clears any corrupted settings.
Start PulseAudio again. It will regenerate default configuration files.

rollback.explain: If you had custom configurations, you may need to restore them from a backup. Otherwise, PulseAudio will use defaults.

warnings: This will reset all per-application volume settings and custom PulseAudio configurations.
